name: scdaw_compose_song
description: Compile a complete multi-bar, multi-track song in one call from a high-level SongSpec (chords, feel, tempo, sections, form, instrumentation, custom riffs). Supports SoundFont GM instruments (electric-bass-finger, acoustic-guitar-steel, electric-guitar-clean, overdriven-guitar, rock-organ, rock-kit) for realistic audio, multiple chords per bar (e.g. 'F Bb | C Bb'), and custom riffs with rests (e.g. motifs: { bass: 'F2:8 F2:8 r:8 A2:8 C3:8' }). Example: scdaw_compose_song({ title: 'Keep on the Sunny Side', bpm: 86, feel: 'blues-rock', swing: 0.3, instruments: { drums: 'rock-kit', bass: 'electric-bass-finger', rhythm: 'electric-guitar-clean', lead: 'overdriven-guitar' }, sections: [{ name: 'verse', bars: 8, chords: 'F Bb | C Bb' }], form: ['verse'] })

swing.description: Swing factor between 0.0 and 1.0 (e.g. 0.3 for blues-rock shuffle)

instruments.description: Map of track roles to instrument names e.g. { drums: 'rock-kit', bass: 'electric-bass-finger', rhythm: 'electric-guitar-clean', lead: 'overdriven-guitar' }. Use SoundFont GM names (electric-bass-finger, acoustic-guitar-steel, electric-guitar-clean, overdriven-guitar, rock-organ, rock-kit) for realistic audio. Use 'synth' only when electronic chiptune/synthwave is desired.

chords.description: Chord progression string. Supports bar delimiters and multiple chords per bar (e.g. 'F Bb | C Bb' or 'E | E | A | B')

sections.description: Defined musical sections with chord progressions and bar lengths

form.description: Arrangement structure ordering the sections e.g. ['intro', 'verse', 'chorus', 'verse', 'chorus', 'solo', 'outro']

motifs.description: Melodic motifs and custom signature riffs mapped by role (e.g. { bass: 'F2:8 F2:8 r:8 A2:8 C3:8 D3:8 F3:4', rhythm: 'r:4 F4:8 r:8', lead: 'F4:8 A4:8 C5:4' }). Supports pitch tokens (e.g. F2:8, C3:4) and rests (e.g. r:8, _:16, rest:4). When a bass or rhythm motif is provided, it repeats across sections as the song's signature hook.

riffs.description: Alias for motifs: custom riffs mapped by role (bass, rhythm, lead, drums)
